create.name: Center for Contemporary Mysticism
create.bio:
Founded in Philadelphia in 2013 and funded by its members, the Center for Contemporary Mysticism is a nonprofit tied to no institution. It belongs to no single faith: its programmes range across mindfulness, Christian and interfaith mysticism, metaphysics and the wisdom traditions, and they are open to anyone who comes with a sincere interest. Its coordinator, Joseph Irwin, oversees a calendar that has drawn a community of some two thousand members and friends, in the Philadelphia area and far beyond. Events used to meet in Chestnut Hill, hosted by St. Paul's Episcopal Church, and today most take place online, with hybrid gatherings planned.

The core of its work is a series of Sunday-afternoon conversations with authors, clergy and teachers on mystical experience, near-death accounts, contemplative Christianity and spiritual growth, along with seasonal day retreats each spring and autumn. Small groups meet as well, among them a free online course that explores the lives of individual mystics through short presentations and discussion. Recordings of the talks go to its YouTube channel, started in 2021, with older programmes kept on a separate archive channel.

courses.title: Loving the Fire w/ Deborah Santana
courses.description: A Sunday-afternoon conversation with the author Deborah Santana about spiritual rebirth, listening to one's own spirit and following the call of the heart, drawing on her two memoirs.

courses.title: The Annihilated Self w/ Fr. James Twyman
courses.description: An afternoon conversation with the author and priest James Twyman on union with Love and letting the separate self fall away.

courses.title: The New Big Book of Christian Mysticism w/ Carl McColman
courses.description: Carl McColman discusses his guide to Christian mysticism and asks whether a renewed contemplative current can revive the faith, taking a broad and inclusive view.

courses.title: Spring Spiritual Retreat w/ Mabeth Hudson
courses.description: A day retreat, in person and by livestream, titled 'Returning Home to Your Soul', exploring connection, belonging and love.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Annual membership at several levels supports the centre's programmes, which depend on members and donors. Memberships are tax-deductible in the US.
courses.price: $ 35 Participating Member; $ 65 Strengthening Member; $ 100 Supporting Member; $ 250 Sponsoring Member; $ 500 + Sustaining Member

free_resources.title: Journeying with the Mystics (online course)
free_resources.description: A free online course, by registration, that meets every other week. Each session pairs two brief talks on chosen mystics, from early Christian writers to modern figures, with open discussion.
